q.en: Your friend is on the swing and you want a turn. What is a kind thing to do?
q.hg: Tumhara dost jhoole par hai aur tumhe bhi jhoolna hai. Kind tareeka kya hoga?

options.en: Hold the swing so they have to stop
options.hg: Jhoola pakad lo taaki use rukna pade

options.en: Ask, 'Can I have a turn after you?'
options.hg: Poocho, 'Tumhare baad meri turn?'

options.en: Say you will never play with them again
options.hg: Bol do ki ab kabhi uske saath nahi kheloge

explain.en: Asking and waiting for your turn is fair to both of you and keeps the game fun.
explain.hg: Poochna aur apni turn ka wait karna dono ke liye fair hai aur khel ka mazaa bana rehta hai.

q.en: Someone posts an embarrassing photo of your classmate Tara in the class group and people are adding laughing emojis. What is the best thing to do?
q.hg: Koi class group mein tumhari classmate Tara ki embarrassing photo daal deta hai aur log laughing emojis bhej rahe hain. Sabse achha kya karna hoga?

options.en: Add an emoji too so you do not stand out
options.hg: Tum bhi ek emoji bhej do taaki alag na dikho

options.en: Forward it to one close friend only
options.hg: Bas ek close dost ko forward kar do

options.en: Do not react or forward, check on Tara, and tell a teacher or parent
options.hg: Na react karo na forward, Tara ka haal poocho, aur teacher ya parent ko batao

options.en: Post an embarrassing photo of the sender
options.hg: Bhejne wale ki bhi embarrassing photo daal do

explain.en: Every reaction and forward spreads the hurt. Refusing to join in, supporting Tara and involving an adult stops it without starting a new fight.
explain.hg: Har reaction aur forward se hurt aur failta hai. Isme shamil na hona, Tara ko support karna aur kisi adult ko involve karna ise rokta hai, bina naya jhagda shuru kiye.

q.en: Which sentence is a clear and respectful boundary?
q.hg: Kaunsa sentence ek clear aur respectful boundary hai?

options.en: If you go out with them, we are over.
options.hg: Agar tum unke saath gaye, toh hum khatam.

options.en: You never care about what I want.
options.hg: Tumhe kabhi care nahi hoti ki mujhe kya chahiye.

options.en: Whatever. Do what you like.
options.hg: Whatever. Jo mann kare karo.

options.en: I'm not comfortable sharing my location. I'll message you when I get home.
options.hg: Main apni location share karne mein comfortable nahi hoon. Ghar pahunch kar tumhe message kar dunga/dungi.

explain.en: A boundary states your own limit and what you will do. An ultimatum controls the other person, an accusation attacks them and 'whatever' hides what you need.
explain.hg: Boundary tumhari apni limit aur tum kya karoge, yeh batati hai. Ultimatum saamne wale ko control karta hai, accusation attack hai, aur 'whatever' tumhari need chhupa deta hai.

q.en: Meher clearly remembers Kunal shouting at her at a party. Every time she brings it up he says, 'That never happened, you imagine things,' and this has happened with many incidents. What is this pattern called?
q.hg: Meher ko clearly yaad hai ki Kunal ek party mein us par chillaya tha. Jab bhi woh yeh baat uthati hai, Kunal bolta hai, 'Aisa kabhi hua hi nahi, tum imagine karti ho,' aur aisa kai incidents ke saath ho chuka hai. Is pattern ko kya kehte hain?

options.en: Gaslighting
options.hg: Gaslighting

options.en: Love bombing
options.hg: Love bombing

options.en: Peer pressure
options.hg: Peer pressure

options.en: Setting a boundary
options.hg: Boundary set karna

explain.en: Repeatedly denying events a person clearly remembers, so that they doubt their own mind, is gaslighting. The repetition across many incidents is what makes it a pattern.
explain.hg: Jo events kisi ko clearly yaad hain unhe baar-baar deny karna, taaki woh apne hi mind par doubt kare, gaslighting hai. Kai incidents mein iska repeat hona hi ise pattern banata hai.

q.en: Under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, only physical violence counts as domestic violence.
q.hg: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 ke under sirf physical violence hi domestic violence maani jati hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: The Act also covers sexual, verbal, emotional and economic abuse, and allows a court to pass protection orders.
explain.hg: Yeh Act sexual, verbal, emotional aur economic abuse ko bhi cover karta hai, aur court protection orders de sakti hai.

q.en: After a breakup, an ex threatens to post your private photos unless you get back together. What should you do first?
q.hg: Breakup ke baad ex dhamki deta hai ki agar tum wapas nahi aaye toh woh tumhari private photos post kar dega. Sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Agree to get back together so they calm down
options.hg: Wapas saath aane ke liye maan jao taaki woh calm ho jaye

options.en: Keep the chat, do not forward the photos, and report with a trusted adult to 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in
options.hg: Chat sambhal kar rakho, photos forward mat karo, aur kisi trusted adult ke saath 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo

options.en: Delete every chat and your account so there is no trace
options.hg: Saari chats aur apna account delete kar do taaki koi trace na bache

options.en: Threaten to post their photos too
options.hg: Tum bhi unki photos post karne ki dhamki do

explain.en: Giving in usually brings more demands, and deleting everything removes the details needed for a report. Threatening to share private images is an offence, and reporting with adult support is the safest route.
explain.hg: Maan jaane se aksar demands aur badhti hain, aur sab kuch delete karne se report ke liye zaroori details mit jati hain. Private images share karne ki dhamki dena offence hai, aur kisi adult ke saath report karna sabse safe raasta hai.
